package web

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestExampleNoticeNameValidation(t *testing.T) {
	if name, message := validateExampleNoticeName("  Launch  "); name != "Launch" || message != "" {
		t.Fatalf("validateExampleNoticeName(padded) = (%q, %q), want (\"Launch\", \"\")", name, message)
	}
	if _, message := validateExampleNoticeName("   "); message == "" {
		t.Fatal("validateExampleNoticeName accepted a blank name")
	}
	if _, message := validateExampleNoticeName(strings.Repeat("x", 81)); message == "" {
		t.Fatal("validateExampleNoticeName accepted a name over the length limit")
	}
}
